summary: Staff can request optional AI draft suggestions into the post editor when NEWSROOM_AI_ASSIST_ENABLED and OPENAI_API_KEY are set. Assist never auto-publishes.
detailed_changes: Added AiAssistService and staff /staff/ai/status + /staff/ai/suggest routes gated by newsroom.ai_assist config (off by default).
Added AiAssistPanel on staff post edit to insert suggestions as a paragraph block into the draft only.
Missing flag or API key hides the panel and returns 503 on suggest.
affected_areas: Internal impact: optional OpenAI-backed draft assist
